_comment: What changed in each release, in the words a shopkeeper would use. Unversioned on purpose: the running app fetches this by a stable URL to show what the INCOMING version brings, so a ?v= here would be a URL the old build cannot know. Newest first. tests/release-notes.test.mjs fails the build if the top entry does not match the stamp in app.html.

en: Adding a product no longer pops up a warning saying it has run out. A new product has no stock until you receive it under Purchases, so there was nothing to warn about — and typing in a long list of products meant dismissing one box per product.
Choosing a different branch no longer opens a warning for every low item in that branch.
A stock warning now waits until you have finished what you were doing. It used to appear on top of a form you were filling in and take the next tap with it.
sw: Kuongeza bidhaa hakuleti tena onyo kwamba imeisha. Bidhaa mpya haina hisa hadi uipokee chini ya Manunuzi, hivyo hakukuwa na kitu cha kuonya — na kuandika orodha ndefu ya bidhaa kulimaanisha kufunga kisanduku kimoja kwa kila bidhaa.
Kuchagua tawi lingine hakufungui tena onyo kwa kila bidhaa yenye hisa ndogo katika tawi hilo.
Onyo la hisa sasa linasubiri hadi umalize unachofanya. Awali lilijitokeza juu ya fomu unayojaza na kuchukua mguso uliofuata.

en: Fixed: after a sale that said “the connection did not answer”, the next sale could be refused as already recorded — and was then not recorded at all. The till kept doing it until the app was reloaded. It now starts a fresh order number as soon as the basket is empty, and a repeat of the SAME basket is still protected against being rung up twice.

Fixed: stock received on credit from a supplier you had not added to the Suppliers list did not reach “You owe suppliers” or the Supplier Balances report. The debt was on the delivery and nowhere else. Typing a new supplier name on a delivery that leaves money owing now creates that supplier with the balance on it. A delivery paid in full still creates nothing.
sw: Imerekebishwa: baada ya mauzo yaliyosema “mtandao haukujibu”, mauzo yaliyofuata yangeweza kukataliwa kuwa tayari yamesajiliwa — na kisha yasisajiliwe kabisa. Kaunta ilikuwa ikiendelea hivyo hadi programu ipakiwe upya. Sasa inaanza namba mpya ya oda mara kikapu kinapokuwa tupu, na kurudia kikapu KILE KILE bado kunalindwa dhidi ya kuuzwa mara mbili.

Imerekebishwa: bidhaa zilizopokelewa kwa mkopo kutoka kwa msambazaji ambaye hukumuweka kwenye orodha ya Wasambazaji hazikufika kwenye “Unachodaiwa na wasambazaji” wala ripoti ya Salio la Wasambazaji. Deni lilikuwa kwenye mzigo peke yake. Sasa kuandika jina jipya la msambazaji kwenye mzigo unaoacha deni kunamtengenezea msambazaji huyo na salio lake. Mzigo uliolipwa wote bado hautengenezi chochote.

en: Every report now asks for a date range instead of a single month. Pick the 3rd to the 19th, or July to September, or a whole year — the Profit Report, Purchases, Expenses, Deliveries and Stock Valuation all ask the same way, and there is a This month button when that is all you wanted.
The per-product table under the Profit Report was showing only the first month of a longer range. It now covers the whole period, so its rows add up to the figures above it.
The VAT record still asks for a month, deliberately: a VAT return is filed for a calendar month, so a figure covering anything else would match no return you will ever submit.
sw: Kila ripoti sasa inauliza kipindi cha tarehe badala ya mwezi mmoja. Chagua tarehe 3 hadi 19, au Julai hadi Septemba, au mwaka mzima — Ripoti ya Faida, Manunuzi, Matumizi, Mizigo na Thamani ya Hisa zote zinauliza kwa njia moja, na kuna kitufe cha Mwezi huu kama hicho ni unachotaka.
Jedwali la bidhaa chini ya Ripoti ya Faida lilikuwa linaonyesha mwezi wa kwanza tu wa kipindi kirefu. Sasa linafunika kipindi chote, hivyo safu zake zinajumlika hadi takwimu zilizo juu yake.
Kumbukumbu ya VAT bado inauliza mwezi, kwa makusudi: marejesho ya VAT yanawasilishwa kwa mwezi wa kalenda, hivyo takwimu inayofunika kitu kingine haitalingana na marejesho yoyote utakayowasilisha.

en: The menu is five entries instead of fourteen: Dashboard, Sell, Stock, Money and More. Nothing was taken away and nothing was renamed, so every screen is still there, one tap further in.
If your job is serving customers, the app now opens straight on the till instead of a dashboard you cannot sell from.
sw: Menyu sasa ina vitu vitano badala ya kumi na vinne: Dashibodi, Uza, Hisa, Fedha na Zaidi. Hakuna kilichoondolewa wala kubadilishwa jina, hivyo kila skrini bado ipo, mguso mmoja zaidi ndani.
Kama kazi yako ni kuhudumia wateja, programu sasa inafunguka moja kwa moja kwenye kaunta badala ya dashibodi usiyoweza kuuzia.

en: The note about Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, Cash Flow and General Ledger has been taken off the Reports screen. Those four need a double-entry ledger, which is being built under Accounts, and the note will come back with them.
sw: Maelezo kuhusu Mizania, Salio la Majaribio, Mtiririko wa Fedha na Leja Kuu yameondolewa kwenye skrini ya Ripoti. Hizo nne zinahitaji leja ya kuingiza mara mbili, ambayo inajengwa chini ya Hesabu, na maelezo yatarudi pamoja nazo.

en: The reference you type on a delivery now shows in the purchases breakdown. It was being looked for in the wrong place and the column came out blank.
sw: Kumbukumbu unayoandika kwenye bidhaa zilizowasili sasa inaonekana kwenye mchanganuo wa manunuzi. Ilikuwa ikitafutwa mahali pasipo sahihi na safu ikatoka tupu.

en: On the Cost of Goods Sold report you can now tap Opening stock, Purchases, Carriage or Closing stock to see what each one is made of. As on the Profit Report, the list adds itself up and tells you whether it reaches the figure on the line.

The owner dashboard now leads with how the shop is doing. Voids, refunds, discounts, faults and mismatched sales have moved under a Checks heading below. Nothing was removed, and they still turn red when they have something to say.
sw: Kwenye ripoti ya Gharama ya Bidhaa Zilizouzwa sasa unaweza kugusa Hisa ya kuanzia, Manunuzi, Usafirishaji au Hisa ya mwisho ili uone kila moja imeundwa na nini. Kama ilivyo kwenye Ripoti ya Faida, orodha inajijumlisha na kukuambia kama inafikia takwimu ya mstari.

Dashibodi ya mmiliki sasa inaanza na hali ya duka. Mauzo yaliyofutwa, marejesho, punguzo, hitilafu na mauzo yasiyolingana yamehamia chini ya kichwa cha Ukaguzi. Hakuna kilichoondolewa, na bado vinageuka vyekundu vikiwa na la kusema.

en: The Profit Report now takes a date range instead of a single month. Pick any two dates, across months or years, or use This month to go back to the default.

Direct costs of selling, such as commission, delivery and packaging, have moved up into cost of sales where a trading account puts them. Gross profit now shows what you kept after everything it took to sell the goods. Your net profit is unchanged.
Opening the cost of sales line lists those direct costs beside the products, so the breakdown still adds up to the figure on the line.
sw: Ripoti ya Faida sasa inachukua kipindi cha tarehe badala ya mwezi mmoja. Chagua tarehe zozote mbili, kuvuka miezi au miaka, au tumia Mwezi huu kurudi kwenye hali ya kawaida.

Gharama za moja kwa moja za kuuza, kama kamisheni, usafirishaji na vifungashio, zimehamia juu kwenye gharama ya mauzo ambapo hesabu ya biashara inaziweka. Faida ghafi sasa inaonyesha ulichobakiza baada ya kila kilichohitajika kuuza bidhaa. Faida yako halisi haijabadilika.
Kufungua mstari wa gharama ya mauzo kunaorodhesha gharama hizo za moja kwa moja kando ya bidhaa, ili mchanganuo uendelee kufikia takwimu ya mstari.

en: On the Profit Report you can now tap Revenue, Cost of goods sold, or either expense line to see exactly what went into it. The list adds itself up and tells you whether it reaches the figure on the line, so you can check the maths rather than take it on trust.
sw: Kwenye Ripoti ya Faida sasa unaweza kugusa Mapato, Gharama ya bidhaa zilizouzwa, au mstari wowote wa matumizi ili uone hasa kilichoingia humo. Orodha inajijumlisha yenyewe na kukuambia kama inafikia takwimu ya mstari, ili uweze kukagua hesabu badala ya kuiamini tu.

en: Cost of goods sold can now be worked out for months before you started recording buying prices. Where a price was not yet recorded, the earliest one you later entered is used, and the report says how many products that applied to.
Stock Valuation now has a date. Pick any day and it shows what was on the shelf then, and what it was worth. Before this the month box beside it never changed the figure at all.
The app opens faster. The security check that used to hold everything up now loads alongside the app instead of in front of it.
sw: Gharama ya bidhaa zilizouzwa sasa inaweza kupigwa hesabu kwa miezi kabla hujaanza kurekodi bei za ununuzi. Pale bei ilipokuwa haijarekodiwa, bei ya kwanza uliyoingiza baadaye ndiyo inatumika, na ripoti inasema bidhaa ngapi zilihusika.
Thamani ya Hisa sasa ina tarehe. Chagua siku yoyote nayo itaonyesha kilichokuwa rafuni wakati huo, na kilikuwa na thamani gani. Kabla ya hapa kisanduku cha mwezi hakikubadilisha takwimu hata kidogo.
Programu inafunguka haraka zaidi. Ukaguzi wa usalama uliokuwa ukizuia kila kitu sasa unapakia sambamba na programu badala ya mbele yake.

en: Every report now says which branch its figures come from. The totals on your dashboard cover all your branches; the reports cover the one picked in the switcher at the top. The two can differ for a good reason, and now you can see which is which.
sw: Kila ripoti sasa inasema takwimu zake zinatoka tawi gani. Jumla zilizo kwenye dashibodi yako zinahusu matawi yako yote; ripoti zinahusu lile lililochaguliwa kwenye kibadilishaji cha juu. Mbili hizo zinaweza kutofautiana kwa sababu nzuri, na sasa unaweza kuona ipi ni ipi.

en: Every notice the app shows you now carries the SaviaSmart name and mark, with a glowing edge in one of three colours: green when it is just the app talking, amber when something wants your attention, red when money or data is at risk.
The payment report was leaving bank sales out of its combined total while still counting them in the number of sales. Bank now appears with the other ways you get paid.
sw: Kila taarifa programu inayokuonyesha sasa ina jina na alama ya SaviaSmart, ikiwa na ukingo unaong aa wa rangi moja kati ya tatu: kijani programu inapoongea tu, njano kitu kinapohitaji uangalizi wako, nyekundu fedha au taarifa zikiwa hatarini.
Ripoti ya malipo ilikuwa ikiacha mauzo ya benki nje ya jumla yake huku ikiyahesabu katika idadi ya mauzo. Benki sasa inaonekana pamoja na njia nyingine unazolipwa.

en: This list now appears in Swahili when the app is set to Swahili. It was showing English whichever language you had chosen.

In a customer history, the column beside a credit sale now says how much of that sale went on credit. It used to be headed as what is still owed, which never changed even after the customer paid. What is still owed is the running figure at the top of that window.
sw: Orodha hii sasa inaonekana kwa Kiswahili programu ikiwa imewekwa kwa Kiswahili. Ilikuwa ikionyesha Kiingereza bila kujali lugha uliyochagua.

Katika historia ya mteja, safu iliyo kando ya mauzo ya mkopo sasa inasema kiasi gani cha mauzo hayo kilienda kwa mkopo. Awali ilikuwa na kichwa cha kinachodaiwa, ambacho hakikubadilika hata mteja alipolipa. Kinachodaiwa ni takwimu inayoendelea juu ya dirisha hilo.

en: The message that tells you a new version is ready now wears the app's own colour and mark, instead of the yellow kept for things that need fixing.
sw: Ujumbe unaokuambia toleo jipya lipo tayari sasa unavaa rangi na alama ya programu yenyewe, badala ya njano inayotumika kwa vitu vinavyohitaji kurekebishwa.

en: When a new version is ready, you can now tap that message to see exactly what changed before you reload.
What changed in each update is also kept in Settings, so you can read it whenever you like.
sw: Toleo jipya likiwa tayari, sasa unaweza kugusa ujumbe ule ili uone hasa kilichobadilika kabla ya kupakia upya.
Kilichobadilika katika kila sasisho pia kinahifadhiwa kwenye Mipangilio, ili uweze kusoma wakati wowote.

en: Your stock value now updates the moment you record a delivery. Before this it could keep pricing the new quantity at the old buying price.
The Stock Valuation report no longer claims your products have no buying price when they do.
A customer history now shows what they were sold on credit at the till, not only invoices and payments, so the balance they owe can be followed.
The Cost of Goods Sold report now says how much stock left on invoices, so the difference against the profit on your dashboard is not mistaken for theft.
The Profit Report now says which branch it is showing.
sw: Thamani ya hisa yako sasa inasasishwa mara tu unaporekodi bidhaa zilizowasili. Kabla ya hapa iliweza kuendelea kupanga kiasi kipya kwa bei ya zamani ya ununuzi.
Ripoti ya Thamani ya Hisa haisemi tena kwamba bidhaa zako hazina bei ya ununuzi wakati zinayo.
Historia ya mteja sasa inaonyesha alichouziwa kwa mkopo kaunta, si ankara na malipo pekee, ili deni analodaiwa liweze kufuatiliwa.
Ripoti ya Gharama ya Bidhaa Zilizouzwa sasa inasema hisa kiasi gani ilitoka kwa ankara, ili tofauti na faida ya dashibodi yako isichukuliwe kama wizi.
Ripoti ya Faida sasa inasema tawi gani inaloonyesha.

en: The Cost of Goods Sold report now explains that supplier discounts are already inside what you paid, instead of leaving a blank figure that looked like missing data.
sw: Ripoti ya Gharama ya Bidhaa Zilizouzwa sasa inaeleza kwamba punguzo la muuzaji tayari limo ndani ya ulicholipa, badala ya kuacha nafasi tupu iliyoonekana kama taarifa zilizokosekana.

en: The Cost of Goods Sold report now names the products that have no buying price, so you can go and fill them in.
It will not show a cost figure that cannot be true. If the sums come out impossible, it says so instead.
sw: Ripoti ya Gharama ya Bidhaa Zilizouzwa sasa inataja bidhaa zisizo na bei ya ununuzi, ili uende ukazijaze.
Haitaonyesha takwimu ya gharama isiyoweza kuwa kweli. Hesabu zikitoka zisizowezekana, inasema hivyo badala yake.

en: The Cost of Goods Sold report now shows a partial figure clearly marked incomplete, rather than showing you nothing at all.
sw: Ripoti ya Gharama ya Bidhaa Zilizouzwa sasa inaonyesha takwimu ya sehemu iliyowekewa alama wazi kuwa haijakamilika, badala ya kutokuonyesha chochote.

en: New report: Cost of Goods Sold. It works out what the goods you sold over a period actually cost you, from your opening stock, what you bought, and your closing stock.
sw: Ripoti mpya: Gharama ya Bidhaa Zilizouzwa. Inahesabu bidhaa ulizouza katika kipindi zilikugharimu kiasi gani hasa, kutokana na hisa ya kuanzia, ulichonunua, na hisa ya mwisho.
